senses.gloss: ch. same, destruction.—*כּילּוּי סִילְוֵי (or סִילְיֵי) destruction of thistles, name of an insect, prob. caterpillar (or bruchus (?), v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 51">Gen. R. s. 51</cite>, beg. (expl. <cite ref="U00141"><he>שבלול</he></cite>, <cite ref="Psalms 58:9">Ps. LVIII, 9</cite>) [read:] <he>כהדין כ׳ סיליי כשלשול וכ׳</he> [<cite ref="L00484"><he>לימצא</he></cite> is a gloss borrowed from a comment. to Ps. l. c. and absent in <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 776">Yalk. Ps. 776</cite>] like the caterpillar, like the abdominal secretion &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:2:3">Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>כקרני סיליי וכיליי</he> (Bab. ed. to VI, 2 Ms. M. <he>סילוי וכילוי</he>, early ed. only <cite ref="O00001"><he>ס׳</he></cite>) the water coming forth from the Temple (<cite ref="Zechariah 14:8">Zech. XIV, 8</cite>) will be … as minute as the horns (feelers) of the caterpillar (thinner than those of <he>חגבים</he>).
